references.title: DWDS: Europa
references.supports: No entry splits the name; a continent's name from Greek Eurṓpē

notes.rationale: ganz Europa, the continent. No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root europa and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
